read.thesis: Strong Q1 with adjusted EPS up 23% to $2.42 and adjusted PFOs ex-PRT up 10%, but earnings lean on variable investment income (up 58% to $518M) and PRT volume fell sharply.

triggers.label: Adj PFOs ex-PRT up 10%
triggers.quote: Adjusted PFOs, excluding pension risk transfers (PRT), 10% to $13.3 billion, with growth in all segments.

triggers.label: Variable investment income up 58%
triggers.quote: Variable investment income up 58% to $518 million, driven by higher private equity returns.

triggers.label: Holding co cash at top of target
triggers.quote: Holding company cash and liquid assets totaled $3.9 billion at quarter end, at top of target range.

guidance.quote: We remain confident in delivering against the ambitious financial targets we laid out under New Frontier.

red_flags.label: Earnings boosted by variable investment income
red_flags.quote: Variable investment income up 58% to $518 million, driven by higher private equity returns.
